Crucial E100 1TB M.2 2280 NVMe PCIe Gen4 Internal Solid State Drive (SSD)

Say goodbye to slow boot times and elevate your daily digital performance with the high-speed Crucial E100 1TB PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSD. Available at Turbo Computer, this budget-friendly internal solid-state drive is expertly engineered by Micron to achieve rapid sequential read performance up to 5000MB/s. It stands as the absolute definitive hardware choice for mainstream PC builders and everyday users across Egypt looking to replace traditional HDDs or legacy SATA drives with seamless Gen4 storage tracking efficiency.

The Crucial E100 is tailored for reliable everyday computing, utilizing premium advanced 3D NAND flash technology to combine enhanced bandwidth with long-term hardware durability. Featuring a standard slim M.2 2280 form factor, it ensures instant, tool-free hardware modification flexibility inside modern desktop motherboards and compact laptops. Operating with massive power-saving management and quiet cooling execution, it serves as an excellent foundational component for your updated system ecosystem.
